title: Pay the regional broadband scheme charge
what: A charge is imposed on carriers' annual chargeable premises amounts (premises connected to their local access lines).

sources.title: Telecommunications (Regional Broadband Scheme) Charge Act 2020
sources.quote: 6 Imposition of charge If a person has an annual chargeable premises amount for an eligible financial year, charge is imposed on that amount.

sources.title: Telecommunications (Consumer Protection and Service Standards) Act 1999
sources.quote: 47 ACMA to assess eligible revenue (1) The ACMA must make a written assessment of each participating person’s eligible revenue for an eligible revenue period (other than the first eligible revenue period).

administration.who: Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts
